description: This file is the main application component for a React web application. It manages user authentication modals (login/signup), imports core components like Header, Footer, Home, Login, Signup, and communicates with external API functions for login and signup actions.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main functional React component that manages authentication modals and handles user login/signup through API calls.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles user login by calling the external API and closing the login modal.

methods.name: handleSignup
methods.description: Handles user signup by calling the external API and closing the signup modal.
